text:
alex: Hey team — first day! Quick q on PR process: what's our branch naming convention and any pre-commit hooks I should run before opening a PR?

maria: welcome alex! branch pattern is feat/<ticket>-short-desc or fix/<ticket>-desc. ticket is JIRA id (e.g., RINF-123). Run pre-commit and `tox -e lint` locally.

sam: also run `./scripts/check_format.sh` — CI enforces it.

alex: thanks! where's the PR template? do we need changelog entries?

maria: template in .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md. For small infra changes no changelog, but feature/behavior changes -> add one + link to issue.

jordan: review SLA: aim for first review within 24h weekdays. For urgent deploys ping me or @oncall.

alex: got it. Any tests required? unit & integration?

tiago: unit tests mandatory, integration when touching runtime or infra. add a small test for new behavior.

alex: CI failed on pre-commit — here's the output:
``
./scripts/check_format.sh
ERROR: trailing whitespace in src/serve/runtime.py:122
``` 
will fix.

dev-bot: CI status — check-lint: failed. See https://ci.redwood.com/build/3456

alex: fixed and pushed. what's the branching workflow for releases? do we branch off main or release/*?

maria: branch off main. we cut release branches from main with tags by release team. If you need a hotfix, create fix/<ticket>-desc and mention RELEASE in PR.

sam: quick tip: `git rebase --autosquash` for fixup commits, squash WIP before marking ready.

alex: perfect, thanks everyone! I'll open the PR in ~30m. :party-parrot: 

maria: welcome aboard :rocket:
